PAY-101.title: Allow PROCESSING to be reported directly as APPROVED
PAY-101.description: Ops noticed a provider webhook that skips PENDING and reports PROCESSING -> APPROVED in one notification. Confirm whether this should be treated as a normal PENDING -> APPROVED transition after normalization.

comments.author: ops-team (synthetic)
comments.text: Resolved in session 1: PROCESSING normalizes to PENDING, so the existing PENDING -> APPROVED rule already covers this.

PAY-102.title: Reject unknown provider statuses without changing stored payment
PAY-102.description: Risk wants confirmation that any unrecognized or missing provider status never overwrites a payment's stored status, even silently.

comments.author: risk-team (synthetic)
comments.text: Resolved in session 2: any transition to UNKNOWN throws InvalidTransitionError and leaves the stored payment untouched.

PAY-103.title: Record a reversal for an approved payment
PAY-103.description: Finance needs to record that a previously APPROVED payment was reversed (e.g. chargeback or manual correction). This introduces a new status, REVERSED, for payments that were approved and then reversed. This request only asks for the change to be specified (scope, transition rules, acceptance criteria, edge cases); implementation is out of scope for this ticket.
PAY-103.notes: REVERSED should only be reachable from APPROVED. Whether DECLINED or PENDING payments can also be reversed is an open question for the spec, not a decision already made.

comments.author: finance-team (synthetic)
comments.text: This is urgent for the month-end close.
